name: Print Friendly
description: A clean print stylesheet for every page: navigation, footers and banners hidden, link addresses shown, sensible page breaks. Plus an optional Print this page button.

panels.title: Print friendly
panels.description: How pages look on paper and whether they get a print button. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Use the print stylesheet
fields.description: Turn this off to print pages exactly as the browser would.

fields.name: show-urls
fields.title: Print link addresses
fields.description: Writes the address of each link after its text, so readers of the paper copy can still find it.

fields.name: hide
fields.title: Also hide when printing
fields.description: CSS selectors, separated by commas, for anything else that should not be printed. For example: .newsletter, #comments

fields.name: button
fields.title: Show a Print this page button
fields.description: A button that opens the browser's print dialog. It is never printed itself.

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Pages to skip
fields.description: Slugs, separated by commas, that print as the browser would and get no button. For example: home, contact
